title: A channel whose close fails holds no other channel's close back, and the kit's close fails once its shutdown ran, as every later close does
notes: Python: tests/test_framework.py::TestOneShutdown::test_a_close_after_a_failed_one_raises_the_same_failure. The order in which the kit closes its channels is open: channel_closes is unordered. The failing channel sits between two others, so that, unless the kit closes it last, a channel closes after it (roomkit closes them in registration order, roomkit-rs in id order: here both close b-fails second). The kit's store is one it closes: the read refused with kit_closed after the failed close shows the store was released before the failure was raised, the shutdown run to its end. A later close answers the same failure and closes no channel again.
